# OneLink Auto-Provisioning Script
# Device: sirari-mt-49152 - sirari
# Generated: 2026-07-18 14:03:11 UTC
# Client WireGuard IP: 10.100.0.27
# Server: onelink.example.com
# Server Public Key: pu5UhOXUOvKBvE8OajYR6VDlaLy22+eenWcT3+5S0ik=
# NOTE: This is a reference template. Live scripts are generated by api/mikrotik.php

# Set router identity
/system identity set name="sirari-mt-49152"

# Create bridge (no VLANs); bridge ports and hotspot/PPPoE are added in Step 3 from dashboard
/interface bridge add comment="OneLink Bridge" name=onelink-bridge

# Single subnet and pool for both DHCP and hotspot/PPPoE (Step 3). DHCP server must use same interface and pool as hotspot.
/ip address add address=10.10.0.1/24 comment="Added by OneLink" interface=onelink-bridge
/ip pool add name=onelink-pool ranges=10.10.0.2-10.10.0.254
/ip dhcp-server add address-pool=onelink-pool disabled=no interface=onelink-bridge name=onelink-dhcp
/ip dhcp-server network add address=10.10.0.0/24 dns-server=8.8.8.8,8.8.4.4 gateway=10.10.0.1

# NOTE: Bridge ports and hotspot/PPPoE are configured in Step 3 (Configure services). Hotspot will use onelink-bridge and onelink-pool (same as DHCP).

# Set up RADIUS for authentication (tunnel IP)
/radius add address=10.100.0.1 secret="onelink123" service=hotspot authentication-port=1812 accounting-port=1813 timeout=3s realm="620ec5e5-d83c-4ad6-b146-dc361f82f669" comment="OneLink RADIUS"
/radius add address=10.100.0.1 secret="onelink123" service=ppp authentication-port=1812 accounting-port=1813 timeout=3s realm="620ec5e5-d83c-4ad6-b146-dc361f82f669" comment="OneLink RADIUS PPP"

# Accept incoming CoA/Disconnect on port 3799 (backend sends Disconnect-Request to terminate sessions)
/radius incoming set accept=yes port=3799

# NOTE: Service-specific RADIUS configuration will be done in Step 3

# Set up WireGuard for backend communication (idempotent: remove existing first so re-run succeeds)
:do { /interface wireguard remove [find name=onelink-wg] } on-error={}
/interface wireguard add mtu=1420 name=onelink-wg private-key="6MwwnztGs5ahRN+3fZJlnFX0AqRGIhOXSBvd9BoJ438=" listen-port=13231

# Add WireGuard IP address (interface removal above clears any previous address)
/ip address add address=10.100.0.27/24 interface=onelink-wg

# Add WireGuard peer (backend server)
/interface wireguard peers add interface=onelink-wg public-key="pu5UhOXUOvKBvE8OajYR6VDlaLy22+eenWcT3+5S0ik=" endpoint-address=onelink.example.com endpoint-port=13231 allowed-address=10.100.0.0/24 persistent-keepalive=25s

# Enable REST API and SSH for remote management (WireGuard network only)
/ip service set api-ssl address=10.100.0.0/24 disabled=no port=8729
/ip service set ssh address=10.100.0.0/24 disabled=no
# Enable RouterOS REST endpoints via `www` (HTTP) for OneLink management (WireGuard network only)
/ip service set www address=10.100.0.0/24 disabled=no port=80

# Create API user for management (remove if present so re-run / partial provision succeeds)
:do { /user remove [find name=onelink-api] } on-error={}
/user add name=onelink-api password="api_08b66437" group=full comment="OneLink Management API"

# Set up firewall rules (idempotent: remove by comment before add so re-run does not duplicate)
:do { /ip firewall filter remove [find chain=input comment="Allow WireGuard"] } on-error={}
:do { /ip firewall filter remove [find chain=input comment="Allow API SSL"] } on-error={}
:do { /ip firewall filter remove [find chain=input comment="Allow REST (www)"] } on-error={}
:do { /ip firewall filter remove [find chain=input comment="Allow SSH from WireGuard"] } on-error={}
:do { /ip firewall filter remove [find chain=input comment="Allow SNMP from WireGuard"] } on-error={}
:do { /ip firewall filter remove [find chain=input comment="Allow RADIUS CoA from server"] } on-error={}
/ip firewall filter add action=accept chain=input comment="Allow WireGuard" protocol=udp dst-port=13231
/ip firewall filter add action=accept chain=input comment="Allow API SSL" protocol=tcp dst-port=8729 src-address=10.100.0.0/24
/ip firewall filter add action=accept chain=input comment="Allow REST (www)" protocol=tcp dst-port=80 src-address=10.100.0.0/24
/ip firewall filter add action=accept chain=input comment="Allow SSH from WireGuard" protocol=tcp dst-port=22 src-address=10.100.0.0/24
/ip firewall filter add action=accept chain=input comment="Allow SNMP from WireGuard" protocol=udp dst-port=161 src-address=10.100.0.0/24
/ip firewall filter add action=accept chain=input comment="Allow RADIUS CoA from server" dst-port=3799 protocol=udp src-address=10.100.0.0/24

# Enable SNMP for router monitoring (identity, uptime, resources)
/snmp set enabled=yes
/snmp community add name=onelink addresses=10.100.0.0/24

# Set up masquerading for internet access
/ip firewall nat add action=masquerade chain=srcnat comment="OneLink Internet Access"

# Log successful provisioning
/log info "OneLink provisioning completed successfully"
/log info "Device ID: 620ec5e5-d83c-4ad6-b146-dc361f82f669"
/log info "WireGuard Client IP: 10.100.0.27"

:put "======================================"
:put "OneLink Provisioning Complete!"
:put "======================================"
:put "Device ID: 620ec5e5-d83c-4ad6-b146-dc361f82f669"
:put "Client IP: 10.100.0.27"
:put "Server IP: 10.100.0.1"
:put "======================================"
